name: Vowelshiftconsonantkeep

description_json.name: VowelShiftConsonantKeep
description_json.idea: To maximize the model's reasoning capabilities and eliminate garbled outputs, this cipher leaves all consonants, numbers, spaces, and punctuation completely untouched. It only shifts vowels (a, e, i, o, u) forward by one position in the vowel sequence, preserving case. This maintains high readability for the model while providing a simple, low-noise obfuscation layer.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Only vowels are modified. Each vowel is replaced by the next vowel in the sequence [a, e, i, o, u] (a->e, e->i, i->o, o->u, u->a). Case is preserved (A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A). All consonants, digits, spaces, and punctuation marks remain completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Only vowels are modified. Each vowel is replaced by the previous vowel in the sequence [a, e, i, o, u] (a->u, e->a, i->e, o->i, u->o). Case is preserved (A->U, E->A, I->E, O->I, U->O). All consonants, digits, spaces, and punctuation marks remain completely unchanged.

example.plaintext: This is a simple test of the cipher.
